title: Check Consecutive Elements in Array

content.problemStatement:
Consecutive elements

Write a program that checks whether the elements in an unsorted array appears consecutively or not

For example:

The given array is:

7 4 3 5 6 2

The appearance of elements in the array are consecutive.

The given array is:

7 4 4 5 6 2

The appearence of elements in the array are not consecutive.
content.inputFormat: The input contains the size and the elements of the array

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Check if array elements can be sorted into contiguous consecutive integers.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    n = int(toks[0])
    s = sorted(int(x) for x in toks[1:n+1])
    print("Yes" if all(s[i+1] - s[i] == 1 for i in range(n - 1)) else "No")
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Sort array and verify arr[i+1] - arr[i] == 1 for all adjacent pairs.

hints: Check if adjacent difference is strictly 1.
